name: Thoth
body:
THOTH
CR 30

XP 6,881,200
N Medium outsider (god)
Init +7; Senses blindsight 500 ft., darkvision 60 ft., true seeing; Perception +64

DEFENSE

AC 52 touch 36, flat-footed 45 (+16 armor, +7 Dex, +19 deflection)
hp 920 (40d10 +520)
Fort +36, Ref +19, Will + 40
DR 19/-; SR 41

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +5 icy burst speed void quarterstaff +50 (1d6+10+2d6 cold DC 50 L-damage/1d6 +10)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 30th)
Domain Spells

9th–foresight, mage’s disjunction (DC 40)
8th–discern location, protection from spells (DC 39)
7th–legend lore, spell turning (DC 38)
6th–antimagic field, find the path (DC 37)
5th–spell resistance, true seeing (DC 36)
4th–divination, imbue with spell ability (DC 35)
3rd–dispel magic, speak with dead (DC 34)
2nd–detect thoughts, magic mouth (DC 33)
1st–comprehend languages, identify (DC 32)
19/day–summon (any creatures, combined CR of 30 or less)

Str 20, Dex 24, Con 34, Int 58, Wis 52, Cha 32
Base Atk +40; CMB +45; CMD +52
Feats Brew Potion, Combat Casting, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Rod, Craft Staff, Craft Wondrous Item, Deific Casting, Empower Spell, Enlarge Spelll, Extend Spell, Forge Ring, Greater Spell Penetration, Heighten Spell, Legendary Magic, Maximize Spell, Scribe Scroll, Silent Spell, Spell Penetration, Still Spell, Widen Spell
Skills Acrobatics +47, Appraise +64, Bluff +65, Climb +45, Craft (alchemy) +67, Craft (armor) +67, Craft (cloth) +67, Craft (clothing) +67, Craft (weapons) +67, Diplomacy +51, Disable Device +56, Disguise +51, Fly +47, Handle Animal +51, Heal +61, Intimidate +51, Knowledge (arcane) +67, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +64, Knowledge (engineering) +64, Knowledge (history) +64, Knowledge (planes) +67, Knowledge (nature) +64, Knowledge (religion) +67, Perception +64, Profession (apothecary) +61, Profession (scribe) +61Sense Motive +64, Spellcraft +67, Stealth +50, Use Magic Device +54
Special Qualities Deific Traits: Master of Healing, Primal Potency, Supernatural Intelligence (+10), Supernatural Wisdom (+10) Deific Weaknesses: Ritual of Deicide (among the uncountable volumes within Thoth’s library lies a scroll depicting a ritual that could end even a master of secret knowledge such as Thoth.)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aligned Strike (Su)

A deity’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as being aligned to both sides of the deity’s alignment and as being epic for the purpose of resolving damage reduction.

Domain Mastery (Sp)

Thoth possesses the Knowledge and Magic domains. He may use any domain powers and cast any spells associated with his domains at-will. Thoth counts as a 30th level cleric for the purposes of domain powers and caster level. The DCs of these spells are Wisdom based.

Secret Knowledge (Sp)

Thoth is the keeper of the mystical and mysterious knowledge of his pantheon. Thoth may cast any spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list at-will as a spell-like ability though he must still use any material components or foci called for by the spells he casts. Thoth’s effective caster level is equal to his HD for the purposes of this ability. Additionally, Thoth may cast spells as a 30th level sorcerer thus allowing him to apply metamagic feats to his spells. Thoth is considered to know all spells from the sorcerer/wizard spell list for the purposes of his sorcerous casting. The DCs of these spell-like abilities are Intelligence based.

Deific Archmage (Sp)

Thoth may cast any sacred spell atwill as a spell-like ability. Thoth must still use the material components and foci called for by the spell. Thoth’s effective caster level is equal to his HD for the purposes of this ability. The DCs of these spell-like abilities are Intelligence based.

Semi-Unlimited Wish (Sp)

The deity may cast unlimited wish once per day as a spell-like ability that does not require material components. The unlimited wish may only be in regards to something within the deity’s purview. A god of oceans could cause global draught or flooding, for instance, but could not produce any effect unrelated to oceans.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure triple standard, bracers of armor + 16, +5 icy burst speed void quarterstaff
